title: Voice Agents
description: A comprehensive platform for building real-time AI voice agents with multi-provider telephony support (Twilio & WebSockets), BullMQ job processing, and modular integrations across Deepgram, ElevenLabs, and OpenAI.

title: RAGVault
description: RAGVault is a CLI tool to use RAG(Retrieval Augmented Generation) in your terminal using local vector database which does embeddings locally and also answers your queries using default chromaDB LLM or you can use your own LLM
